plain: Zebra only verifies transactions with version 4 or later in this path. Older formats (v1 to v3) cannot be submitted any more; rebuild the transaction with a current wallet.

message: transaction version {0} not supported by the network upgrade {1:?}
plain: This transaction version is not valid at the network upgrade active at the verification height. Version 6 transactions (ZIP 229) are only valid from NU6.3 Ironwood; version 5 from NU5. Build the transaction with the version the current upgrade accepts, or wait until the upgrade that introduces it activates.

message: must have at least one input: transparent, shielded spend, or joinsplit
plain: The transaction has no transparent inputs, no Sapling spends, no enabled Orchard or Ironwood spends and no JoinSplits, so it spends nothing. Add an input.

message: must have at least one output: transparent, shielded output, or joinsplit
plain: The transaction has no transparent outputs, no Sapling outputs, no enabled Orchard or Ironwood outputs and no JoinSplits. Add an output, including a change output if needed.

message: could not verify a transparent script: {0}
plain: A transparent input's scriptSig did not satisfy the scriptPubKey of the output it spends; the inner message is the zcash_script result. Usually the signature was made for different sighash data (wrong prevout value, wrong branch ID or a modified transaction) or with the wrong key. Re-sign the transaction after every field is final.

message: spend description cv and rk MUST NOT be of small order
plain: Zebra reports "spend description cv and rk MUST NOT be of small order" during proof and signature verification.

message: spend proof MUST be valid given a primary input formed from the other fields except spendAuthSig: {0}
plain: A Sapling spend or output Groth16 proof does not verify against its public inputs. The proof was made for different data (for example the transaction changed after proving) or the proving parameters are wrong. Rebuild and re-prove the transaction.

message: Groth16 proof is malformed: {0}
plain: Zebra reports "Groth16 proof is malformed: {0}" during proof and signature verification.

message: Sapling bindingSig MUST represent a valid signature under the transaction binding validating key bvk of SigHash: {0}
plain: The Sapling binding signature (or a spend authorization signature) does not verify over the transaction's signature hash. Usually the value balance or another field changed after signing. Re-sign the final transaction.

message: Orchard bindingSig MUST represent a valid signature under the transaction binding validating key bvk of SigHash: {0}
plain: The Orchard or Ironwood binding signature (or a spend authorization signature) does not verify over the transaction's signature hash. Usually a field changed after signing. Re-sign the final transaction.

message: Sapling proof or signature verification failed
plain: Zebra's batched Sapling verifier rejected a proof or a signature (spendAuthSig or bindingSig) in this transaction. Rebuild the transaction so that proofs and signatures are computed over the final transaction data.

message: Orchard or Ironwood Halo2 proof verification failed
plain: The Halo 2 proof of the Orchard or Ironwood bundle does not verify. The bundle was changed after proving, or the prover used different circuit parameters. Rebuild and re-prove the bundle with a current orchard crate.

message: could not convert an asynchronous verification error: {0}
plain: An asynchronous proof or signature verifier returned an error type Zebra did not recognise, so the original reason is inside the message. If the message mentions Elapsed, the verifier timed out (a node load problem, not an invalid transaction); otherwise read the original error text in the message.

message: either vpub_old or vpub_new must be zero
plain: Zebra reports "either vpub_old or vpub_new must be zero" during transaction verification.

message: adding to the sprout pool is disabled after Canopy
plain: Adding value to the Sprout pool is disabled since Canopy (ZIP 211): JoinSplits may only take value out (vpub_old must be 0). Move Sprout funds out instead.

message: the Orchard value balance must be non-negative from NU6.3 onward
plain: From NU6.3 the Orchard pool is closed to new value: valueBalanceOrchard must be zero or positive (ZIP 258). A negative balance would move value into Orchard. Send new shielded value to Ironwood instead; spending Orchard notes out of the pool is still allowed.

message: could not calculate the transaction fee
plain: Zebra could not compute the miner fee from the transaction's inputs, outputs and shielded value balances, for example because the sum overflows or is negative. Check that the transparent inputs are worth at least the outputs plus the fee, and that the value balances are correct.

plain: The transaction has Orchard actions but neither enableSpendsOrchard nor enableOutputsOrchard is set, so the actions could do nothing. Rebuild the bundle with the right flags or drop the empty Orchard bundle.

message: must have at least one active ironwood flag
plain: The transaction has Ironwood actions but neither enableSpendsIronwood nor enableOutputsIronwood is set. Rebuild the Ironwood bundle with the right flags or drop it.

message: could not find transparent input UTXO in the best chain or mempool
plain: A transparent input spends an output that Zebra cannot find in the best chain or the mempool. The parent transaction may not be mined or broadcast yet, may be on a different network, or the output was already spent. Broadcast the parent first, or check the prevout txid (display byte order) and index.

plain: Zebra reports "immature transparent coinbase spend: attempt to spend {outpoint:?} at {spend_height:?}, but spends are invalid before {min_spend_height:?}, which is {MIN_TRANSPARENT_COINBASE_MATURITY:?} blocks after it was created at {created_height:?}" during contextual validation against the chain state.

plain: Zebra reports "unshielded transparent coinbase spend: {outpoint:?} must be spent in a transaction which only has shielded outputs" during contextual validation against the chain state.

message: failed to verify ZIP-317 transaction rules, transaction was not inserted to mempool: {0}
plain: The mempool applies the ZIP 317 relay rules before proof verification and refused the transaction. The inner message says which rule: unpaid actions above the limit, or a fee below the minimum fee rate. Pay at least the conventional fee, marginal_fee times max(2, logical actions). Note the marginal fee differs by node version: Zebra 6.4.x and 7.0.0-rc.0 use 1,000 zatoshi (ZIP 2009), while Zebra 6.3.0, ZIP 317 as first written and zcash_primitives use 5,000 zatoshi. Paying the 5,000 rate is accepted by both.

message: mempool transaction has {count} {pool}, exceeding the next block's ZIP 218 limit of {limit}
plain: Zebra reports "mempool transaction has {count} {pool}, exceeding the next block's ZIP 218 limit of {limit}" during mempool admission.

message: mempool transaction input {input_index} has a {size} byte scriptSig, above the {MAX_STANDARD_SCRIPTSIG_SIZE} byte standardness limit
plain: Zebra reports "mempool transaction input {input_index} has a {size} byte scriptSig, above the {MAX_STANDARD_SCRIPTSIG_SIZE} byte standardness limit" during mempool admission.

message: mempool transaction input {input_index} has a non-push-only scriptSig

message: mempool transaction has non-standard transparent inputs
plain: Zebra reports "mempool transaction has non-standard transparent inputs" during mempool admission.

message: transaction uses an incorrect consensus branch id
plain: The transaction's nConsensusBranchId (v5 and v6 header) is not the branch ID of the network upgrade active at the height Zebra verifies it for. Zebra compares the two in zebra-consensus/src/transaction/check.rs consensus_branch_id. This usually means the wallet signed for the previous upgrade, for example NU6.2 (0x5437f330) after NU6.3 Ironwood (0x37a5165b) activated on mainnet at 3,428,143, or the transaction was built for the other network. Rebuild and re-sign it with the current branch ID; the signature hashes (ZIP 244) commit to the branch ID, so editing the header alone is not enough.

message: wrong tx format: tx version is ≥ 5, but `nConsensusBranchId` is missing
plain: A version 5 or later transaction must carry nConsensusBranchId, and Zebra could not map it to a known network upgrade. Check that the transaction bytes are complete and were serialized for the current network; rebuild it with a current wallet library.

message: Orchard proof has a non-canonical size
plain: The Orchard proof is not the canonical size of 2720 + 2272 times nActionsOrchard bytes. Zebra enforces this from NU6.2 (ZIP 257) in zebra-consensus/src/transaction.rs. A correct prover always emits the canonical size; extra or missing bytes mean the bundle was assembled incorrectly.

message: Ironwood proof has a non-canonical size
plain: The Ironwood proof is not the canonical size for its number of actions. Zebra enforces this unconditionally for every Ironwood bundle (zebra-consensus/src/transaction.rs). Rebuild the bundle with a correct prover.

plain: The same transparent output is spent twice, either inside one transaction or by two transactions in the same block. Remove the repeated input or wait for the conflicting transaction to settle.

message: unshielded transparent coinbase spend: {outpoint:?} must be spent in a transaction which only has shielded outputs
plain: A transparent coinbase output may only be spent by a transaction that has no transparent outputs; its value must go to shielded outputs. Rebuild the transaction to shield the coinbase funds.

message: transaction rejected because another transaction in the mempool has already spent some of its inputs
plain: Another transaction already in the mempool spends at least one of the same transparent outputs or reveals the same nullifier. Only one of them can be mined. Wait for the first to confirm or expire instead of resubmitting a conflicting spend.

message: transaction rejected because it spends missing outputs from another transaction in the mempool
plain: The transaction spends an output that another mempool transaction was expected to create, and that output is missing. Make sure the parent transaction is accepted into the mempool first, then resubmit.

message: best chain tip has reached transaction expiry height
plain: The mempool dropped or refused the transaction because the best chain tip reached its expiry height. It will not be mined. Build and broadcast a new transaction with a later expiry height.

message: transaction inputs were spent, or nullifiers were revealed, in the best chain
plain: The transaction's transparent inputs were already spent, or its nullifiers already revealed, in the best chain. The funds are gone from this note or output; the wallet needs to rescan and build a new transaction from unspent funds.

message: transaction was committed to the best chain
plain: The transaction was already committed to the best chain. Nothing to resend; look it up by txid.
